text: An ACCEPT from article_reviewer.py is not a clean final: on 2026-11-18 the accepted rewrite had silently dropped the earned inline internal link and the 0.63 comparator figure, both of which the standard battery (accessibility, critic, shape, headline, source_gate) still passed because a comparator that is merely absent is not a wrong figure. After every ACCEPT, diff the _final.md against the _draft.md for (a) '](/…)' link count and (b) every figure that carries an argument, then re-gate.

A same-day pair of arXiv papers can be the strongest collision of a 30-day window and still seed candidates=0: synthesize_topics.py needs the two legs on different source domains, so two arxiv.org anchor rows are invisible to it whatever they argue. Record the zero as input, assert the pair in the angle brief with both bodies read, and expect the seeded block to hold only a mechanical pair built from the one off-host row — score that pair and refuse it in the runner-ups rather than treating it as the story.

An evergreen evidence cell that leads with a comma-grouped figure ('3,001', '15,120') splits into stray numeric tokens in figure_patterns ('3'/'001', '15'/'120') and the PASS excerpt then quotes an unrelated citation or table-of-contents line; lead the cell with the ungrouped token (949, 88, 45) and leave the grouped form later in the sentence.

Review-held rewrite (2026-11-25 MCP mandate piece): the frontier reviewer's own rewrite DEGRADED the article - Flesch 40.5, truncated the frontmatter Signal-A URL (dropped '-now-available', which would red --check-briefs), wrote MCP/REST as comma-appositives the acronym gate rejects as undefined, named bare 'GPT' (write 'OpenAI's flagship' instead), dropped the inline internal link and the first-person cue in the catch. Hand-repair from the _held.md, not the _draft: restore full URLs, parenthetical '(MCP)' gloss, kill all-caps brand tokens, re-add the [text](/path) link, one first-person cue per gated section, re-run accessibility + gate.

Evergreen hand-repair of a held frontier rewrite: the reviewer's long-word list (committed, identity, contract, runtime, recorded, attempt) is the repair surface — swap committed→paid, rewrite→fix, recorded→saved and keep the reviewer's citation repoints; Flesch moves 45→50 with word swaps alone, no re-generation needed.
